# GAOS v0.20.0 — third-party-verifiable game and agent runs

v0.20 turns a deterministic game run into portable evidence that another
organization can check offline. The release incorporates Arena and
TabletopLabs' v0.19 integration findings and completes the resolved
implementation scope of RFC-010.

## Why v0.20

- **One deterministic core:** the same reducer powers human clients, agent
  environments, authoritative sessions, solvers, and replay.
- **Third-party-verifiable runs:** `gaos.replay` v1.2 binds deterministic
  re-simulation to roster-bound Ed25519 seat chains and independently
  reconstructed commands and timeouts. Verifiers report `trusted`,
  `unverifiable`, or `rejected`.
- **Production session infrastructure:** prepared commit/abort transitions,
  idempotency, reconnect repair, prediction reconciliation, signed interest
  scopes, and CPU-adaptive observation delivery are available without forcing
  products to surrender their worlds, presentation, hosting, or scoring
  policy.

## Verification

TypeScript:

```sh
gaos verify run.gaos-replay.jsonl --adapter ./historical-adapter.mjs
```

Python:

```sh
gaos-verify run.gaos-replay.jsonl --adapter ./historical_adapter.py
```

Verification is local and requires no GAOS account, service, or network
connection. A `trusted` verdict proves computation consistency and declared-key
authorship under the artifact's pinned semantics. Real-world identity,
publication completeness, and wall-clock fairness remain product or scoring
authority policy.

## Migration from v0.19

Observation codec v2 is mandatory in v0.20. Bodies may be `patch`, `snapshot`,
or `unchanged`; clients should pass every envelope through
`applyObservationDelta`. The default adaptive strategy requires a patch to win
by 4× and uses an exponential per-scope circuit breaker after uneconomic
probes. Set `patchStrategy: 'never'` for predictable snapshot CPU while
retaining the v2 envelope.

Durable session consumers must also handle the new `interest` and
`seat-signature` event kinds. See the
[complete migration notes](https://yugao-gaos.github.io/GAOS-TurnBasedGrid-SDK/releases)
and [trust boundary](https://yugao-gaos.github.io/GAOS-TurnBasedGrid-SDK/trust-and-verification).
